# Overview


# Load Required Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)    # Core tidyverse packages
library(readxl)       # read Excel files
library(lme4)         # mixed models
library(lmerTest)     # Kenward–Roger
library(emmeans)      # Estimated mean marginal means
library(multcomp)     # cld() for emmGrid
library(writexl)      # write Excel files

```


# Data preparation
## Load dataset
```{r}
# Import dataset
raw_data <- read_excel("soybean_P_response_dataset.xlsx", sheet = "data")

# Inspect structure
str(raw_data)
```

## Data setup

```{r}
# Convert relevant variables to factors
raw_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(across(c(loc_num, loc_name, trt_name), as.factor))

# Define treatment order (used in models and plots)
raw_data$trt_name <- factor(raw_data$trt_name,
  levels = c("0","34 R","67 R","101 R","134 R","34 D","67 D","101 D"))

```



## Split data by application pathway
```{r}
# Residual P (corn phase): no direct P applied
df_corn_raw <- raw_data %>% 
  filter(P_soy == 0)

# Direct P (soybean phase): no residual P applied
df_soy_raw  <- raw_data %>% 
  filter(P_corn == 0)

# Define a common P variable for modeling
df_corn_raw$P <- df_corn_raw$P_corn
df_soy_raw$P  <- df_soy_raw$P_soy


```

# Residual 
## Analysis dataset

```{r}
# Standardize variable names for modeling
model_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    response = yield_mg_ha,
    trt      = trt_name,
    rep      = rep
  )

```

```{r}
# Split dataset by site
data_list <- split(model_data, model_data$loc_num)

results_all_sites <- tibble()

for (i in data_list) {

  # Skip if insufficient variation
  if (nlevels(i$trt) < 2 || all(is.na(i$response))) next

  # Fit model
  model_site <- lmer(response ~ trt + (1 | rep),
                     data = i, REML = TRUE)

  # ANOVA
  anov <- anova(model_site, ddf = "Kenward-Roger")

  # Extract p-value
  p_value <- anov["trt", "Pr(>F)"]
  p_value_2 <- if (is.finite(p_value) && p_value < 0.001) "<0.001" else sprintf("%.3f", p_value)

  # Estimated means and grouping
  means <- emmeans(model_site, ~ trt, lmer.df = "kenward-roger")

  # Dunnett test: all treatments vs control
  results <- contrast(
    means,
    method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
    ref = "0",
    adjust = "dunnett"
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      Responsive = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, 1, 0),
      Sites       = as.character(i$loc_num[1]),
      Location    = as.character(i$loc_name[1]),
      p_value_num = p_value,
      P_Value     = p_value_2
    )

  # Store results
  results_all_sites <- bind_rows(results_all_sites, results)
}

results_all_sites

str(results_all_sites)

#write_xlsx(results_all_sites, "./Anova results_all_sites Direct.xlsx")

```


```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
df <- results_all_sites %>%
  mutate(
    trt = gsub(" - 0", "", contrast)
  )


# Reorder treatment levels
df$trt <- factor(
  df$trt,
  levels = c(
    "34 R",
    "67 R",
    "101 R",
    "134 R",
    "34 D",
    "67 D",
    "101 D"
  )
)
```


```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}

Fig_1 <- ggplot(df,
       aes(x = trt,
           y = factor(Responsive),
           fill = factor(Responsive))) +
  
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Sites, ncol = 3) +
  
  scale_fill_viridis_d(
    option = "cividis",
    labels = c("Non-responsive",
               "Responsive"),
    name = "Classification"
  ) +
  
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = c("0" = "Non-responsive",
               "1" = "Responsive")
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Treatment",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 22) +
  
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

Fig_1

```




```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
prob_trt <- df %>%
  group_by(trt) %>%
  summarise(
    prob_response = mean(Responsive),
    n = n()
  )

prob_trt
```


```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
Fig_2 <- ggplot(prob_trt,
       aes(x = trt,
           y = prob_response,
           fill = trt)) +
  
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "cividis") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Probability of response"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 22) +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

Fig_2

```
